expectations.assertion: Reads and follows the repository's tokens, corner treatment and typography instead of applying the ink/squircle/500-weight system
expectations.reason: The agent never read tokens.css, components, or CLAUDE.md because the working directory was empty; it only proposed following them hypothetically.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT replace the project's serif headings, hard corners or bold weights with the design language's rules
expectations.reason: The agent made no edits and its proposal keeps serif headings, bold weight, and 4px hard corners, so it avoided the substitution.

expectations.assertion: Uses the design language only for gaps the project does not define, and says which
expectations.reason: The agent did not inspect the project's definitions and did not identify any gap or cite the design language as a fallback.

expectations.assertion: States that the project's own design system takes precedence
expectations.reason: The agent never states the precedence rule; it only says it would follow the project's files once they are provided.
